Method of Attack: Constructing malicious PAC files containing arbitrary JavaScript code that executes unsandboxed within Node.js processes via vm module escape
Executing arbitrary code during PAC file parsing leading to remote code execution (RCE)
Impacted Systems: Node.js environments using vulnerable versions of pac-resolver, pac-proxy-agent, and degenerator
Attack Vector: Supplying malicious PAC files to vulnerable pac-resolver or pac-proxy-agent packages
Exploitation of vm module sandbox escape in degenerator dependency
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious PAC file containing this.constructor.constructor code execution
npm package pac-resolver with weekly downloads exceeding 3 million
References to process.env and process.exit in PAC file code
